description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and methods for F1AP private information elements in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Class representing a private information element ID with options for local or global types.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 sequence of private IE fields, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for individual private IE container items, handling serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to local and returns the local ID.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to global.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the object into bit reference format.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the object from bit reference format.
